kpiEvidence.K23: Human public comprehension unmeasured. Automated finance/UI tests demonstrate controls, not the requested ≥90% real-person comprehension.
kpiEvidence.K24: Source download, completed-stage distributions, provider wall/failures, recovery waits and total episode wall; concurrent stages are not summed.

limitations: Internal procedural scenarios, scripted human delays and fixed seeds are not external calibration or measured responder productivity.

A descriptive positive point estimate does not establish the proposed magnitude, favorable confidence interval or top-1 status.
Scorer physical fields are read offline only after execution; this reader never passes world truth to a planner or runs a model.
A supplied path omitted from this invocation cannot be silently inferred as successful or zero cost.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical service of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no direct-service credit.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical service of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no direct-service credit.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical service of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no direct-service credit.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

limitations: Offline scorer evidence only; no world truth is exposed to a controller.
Confirmation receipt clocks are not exported per discovery location here; they remain unknown. Submission ACKs and model batch completion are not confirmation completion.
The semantic receipt nominal interpretation clock is not used in this decomposition.
First useful contribution and last quantity-threshold contribution are distinct. A partial path is not presented as a sufficient path.
Mean physical-stage components are descriptive contribution anchors, not a causal effect of model perception. Missing timestamps are not imputed.
Local owner-review timestamps stay wall clocks and are never subtracted from source physical clocks.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical service of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no direct-service credit.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.
